findings.evidence: The current NRSR profile lists residence Nitra, while the 2026 official ballot lists Štitáre. The proposal explicitly acknowledges the difference and joins on exact name, age 44, HLAS affiliation and parliamentary occupation. Those attributes strongly corroborate identity; this review does not allege a wrong-person match. However, the brief requires two additional matching attributes AND no conflicting evidence. A documented municipality mismatch remains unresolved.
